narrative: Income statement, balance sheet and cash flow from one chart of accounts mapped from the Oracle (Hyperion) finance database on Snowflake. Shipper receivables (DSO about 52 days), carrier payables and customs duties advanced for clients all tie out, and every number drills to the journal.

signals.title: Hyperion finance data on Snowflake since September 2024
signals.excerpt: The Oracle/Hyperion finance database was migrated to Snowflake in 2024; budgeting and forecasting still run in Hyperion and Excel. SDP plans on the same governed data.
